steps.title: What Gemini TTS Preview does
steps.body: Gemini preview TTS backend addon for Neural Companion. The overview introduces this area without opening its other sections.

steps.title: Read the preview status first
steps.body: Open Overview and read Status before configuring anything else. It reports whether the preview backend is ready or needs connection details. Use the intro text to note this is a preview. If status names a missing key or endpoint, use Connection rather than retrying speech repeatedly in chat.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Treat this as a preview backend
steps.body: Gemini TTS Preview is labeled a preview, so treat behavior as subject to change and verify speech with a short phrase rather than a long session. Status reflects configuration readiness, not guaranteed voice quality. Keep changes small and record what you set so you can revert easily.

steps.title: Enter connection fields and test
steps.body: In Connection, enter API key, Base URL, and Model. Use Refresh model list or Refresh models if you need to load available models, then choose one. Press Check connection and read its result. A failed result usually points to the key, endpoint, or model name; correct that one field and retest.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Choose a model from the refreshed list
steps.body: After refreshing models, select a model from the list rather than typing an uncertain name. The model determines which speech options this preview can offer. If the list stays empty, check the Base URL and key before refreshing again. Check connection after a new model is chosen.

steps.title: Distinguish a saved setting from a working connection
steps.body: Entering fields stores configuration; Check connection reports whether the backend responded. Read its message rather than assuming success from a filled form. If connection fails, keep the error text so you can match it to the key, endpoint, or model that needs correction.

guides.title: Gemini TTS Preview · Voice
guides.description: Use Voice in Gemini TTS Preview.
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Set voice and language
steps.body: In Voice, choose Voice and set Language code so pronunciation matches your text. Voice and language should agree; a mismatch often produces unexpected speech. After choosing, test a short phrase and listen before applying it to a longer project. Recheck the selected values if the output surprises you.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Add a style prompt deliberately
steps.body: Style prompt guides delivery without changing the underlying voice. Keep it short and descriptive, then test a phrase to judge the effect. If the style dominates or the speech sounds unintelligible, simplify or clear the prompt. Style is optional, so an empty field is a valid choice.

guides.title: Gemini TTS Preview · Voice tag rules
guides.description: Understand the shared voice-tag rules alongside this TTS provider.

steps.title: Read the default voice guidance
steps.body: Voice tag rules describe how NC interprets voice tags alongside this backend. Read the default guidance before changing it; backend selection and reference-audio selection are separate choices. Keeping the existing rules gives you a known baseline for later speech comparisons.

steps.title: Distinguish rules from actual playback
steps.body: A saved rule expresses how voice tags should be interpreted, not proof that a backend accepted the reference or produced audio. A later controlled spoken reply is needed to verify routing. If output changes unexpectedly, compare the rules with their previous text before changing provider settings.
